slides.title:
JUTE BAG
EXPORT BUSINESS
slides.sub: A practical **starter guide** for Indian exporters

slides.label: WHY JUTE BAGS?
bullets: India is the **world's largest producer** of raw jute
Plastic bag rules abroad push buyers to **natural fibre**
Reusable shopping bags are a **growing use** for jute
Big retail chains have already **sourced bags from India**

slides.label: WHAT YOU CAN SELL
bullets: **Shopping and tote bags** for grocery and fashion
**Gift and promo bags** with a printed logo
**Wine and bottle bags** for gift packs
**Hessian sacks** and packing material

slides.label: WHERE IT IS MADE
bullets: **West Bengal** grows most of India's raw jute
Most jute mills are also in **West Bengal**
Many small units stitch **finished bags**
Visit a unit or ask for **video proof** before ordering

slides.label: WHAT BUYERS CHECK
bullets: **Fibre quality**, weave and stitching strength
**Colour and print** that stay consistent in bulk
A **sample first**, then the bulk order
**Labels and carton packing** that match the order
A **factory audit** when the buyer asks for one

slides.label: HOW TO START
bullets: **Pick 2-3 bag styles** you can make well
**Find a maker** in a jute-belt cluster
**Make a sample set** with clear photos
**Confirm the HS code** and rules with your customs broker
**Send samples** to the buyers you shortlisted

slides.label: FIND YOUR BUYERS
bullets: **Retail chains** and eco-friendly brands
**Gift and promo** companies
**Importers** who sell to shops
Check **trade fairs** for home, gift and lifestyle products

caption.body:
Jute bag export business: a practical starter guide for Indian exporters.

India is the world's largest producer of raw jute, and buyers abroad are looking for natural-fibre alternatives to plastic bags. That makes jute shopping bags, tote bags and gift bags a real product to explore.

In this post: why jute works, what you can sell, where the products are made, what buyers check, how to start with a small sample set, and where to find buyers. Always confirm the HS code, labelling and import rules for your target country with your customs broker before shipping.

leadmagnet.title: Jute Bag Export Checklist
leadmagnet.subtitle: From first sample to first shipment

sections.heading: Choose and source
items: Pick 2-3 bag styles (tote, gift, bottle bag)
Shortlist 3 makers in a jute-belt cluster
Ask each maker for samples and a price sheet
Check stitching, handles and colour fastness yourself

sections.heading: Prepare for buyers
items: Photograph a full sample set on a plain background
Write specs: size, weight, material, print method
Decide your minimum order and lead time
Confirm the HS code and labelling with your customs broker

sections.heading: Verify and ship
items: Check the buyer's company name, website and address
Agree payment terms in writing before production
Send a sample first and keep proof of delivery
Pack in cartons that match the order and keep copies of all documents
